statement: Concrete finite-field witness only: over ZMod5, the fixed nonzero vector(1,-1) is in the left kernel of the two-by-one all-ones matrix, and its dot product with(b,b) is zero for every field element b. Kernel-checked decide and existing Mathlib structures establish this instance. The maintained complete project gate passes four named declarations with no trusted-native exception; the new claim covers only the shared-query witness. This demonstrates a row-tag dependence counterexample, not actual curve decompositions, arbitrary batch correctness or a generic probability/cost theorem. Frozen older source/manifest contexts remain unchanged.
